headline: TXT score 15th straight No. 1 on Oricon album chart
sub: 'PERFECT STORM' sells 256,000 copies in its first week in Japan

info.title: At a glance
rows: Most straight No. 1s by overseas act

caption:
TXT just extended their own Oricon record to 15 consecutive No. 1 albums! 🏆

Their 9th mini album 'PERFECT STORM' topped Oricon's weekly album ranking (Nov 30 issue) with 256,000 copies sold during Nov 16-22. That's the most consecutive No. 1s ever for an overseas artist on the chart, a streak that started with 'The Dream Chapter: ETERNITY' in 2020. Title track 'Angel Bite' also hit No. 2 on LINE MUSIC's daily chart for 7 days straight.

📌 Source: Oricon, via Korean media (Etoday, Star News)
